subject: Request to open: Inference Controls Lead — interview runway & approval checklist
body:
--- Message 1 (external) ---
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmetalent.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate intro — Jordan Li (Inference Controls Lead)

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well — I have a strong candidate for the Inference Controls Lead (backfill). Jordan Li is currently at NimbusAI where they led inference reliability/ops for multi-region deployments. Attached: resume and a short take. Jordan is available for first-round interviews the weeks of May 24 and June 7.

Quick highlights:
- 8+ years infra/ML engineering at scale
- Experience building runtime observability and real-time KV cache heuristics
- Comfortable with leadership-facing posturing and vendor discussions

Attaching JordanLi_Resume.pdf. If you want, I can set up a 45m screen + 30m hiring manager follow.

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Acme Talent Partners
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

--- Message 2 (mailbox owner: Priya) ---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Candidate intro — Jordan Li (Inference Controls Lead)

Team — forwarding a candidate from Acme. This is a backfill on the Inference Controls lead role (reporting to Marissa). I’d like to open the req if leadership is comfortable and confirm the interview panel slate so we can lock calendar slots with the candidate.

Asks: 
- Can leadership approve opening the requisition (attached req_inference_lead_form_v2.xlsx)? We need headcount source and cost center.
- Marissa — can you confirm interviewers and the evaluation rubric + suggested panel order? I put a preliminary panel in interview_panel_matrix.docx (SME screen, system design, leadership conversation).
- Aditya — availability constraints for infrastructure/ops interview between May 24–28?

Attachments: JordanLi_Resume.pdf; req_inference_lead_form_v2.xlsx; interview_panel_matrix.docx

Next steps if approved: I’ll create the GH job and ask recruiter to book a 45m screen + 60m panel for the HM loop.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
---
Priya Natarajan
---

--- Message 3 (Marissa, hiring manager) ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate intro — Jordan Li (Inference Controls Lead)

Priya / Laura —

I reviewed the resume; Jordan looks relevant. I approve opening the req for a backfill. Cost center: ENG-INFRA; headcount is already budgeted for Q2 headcount refresh (code ENG-22-42).

Panel I propose (order):
1) 45m Technical screen (senior infra engineer) — focus: latency/kv cache behavior, quantization tradeoffs
2) 60m System design + architecture (Marissa + senior infra) — real scenarios: model routing, fallback policies
3) 30m Leadership/cross-functional (product/ops) — ownership and SLA conversations

Interviewer names (requested): Lukasz Meyer (backend infra), Aditya Rao (runtime), Laura/Me for HM convo. Please add Rory from Security for a quick compliance Q (15m).

Please greenlight GH posting and booking. I can do first-round debriefs the week after initial screens.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Inference Platform | Redwood Inference

On Mon, May 17, 2027 at 09:11 AM Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding a candidate from Acme. This is a backfill on the Inference Controls lead role (reporting to Marissa). I’d like to open the req if leadership is comfortable and confirm the interview panel slate so we can lock calendar slots with the candidate.

--- Message 4 (Laura, leadership) ---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate intro — Jordan Li (Inference Controls Lead)

Thanks — I’m comfortable approving the requisition to open. Two asks before you post: 
1) Confirm ENG-INFRA cost center and job banding (Marissa mentioned ENG-22-42; please put banding in the req form).
2) We should target a 3-week interview runway to avoid losing the candidate — please prioritize first-round within May 24–28 if candidate is available.

Looping in Aditya to confirm interviewer availability.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering Operations | Redwood Inference

On Tue, May 18, 2027 at 10:03 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Priya / Laura —
> I reviewed the resume; Jordan looks relevant. I approve opening the req for a backfill. Cost center: ENG-INFRA; headcount is already budgeted for Q2 headcount refresh (code ENG-22-42).

--- Message 5 (Aditya, scheduling constraints) ---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 12:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate intro — Jordan Li (Inference Controls Lead)

Quick scheduling note — I’m out May 25–26 for on-call rotation handover (OOO). Lukasz has limited mornings (9–11 PT) on May 24–28. Rory (security) is available afternoons only. If we want a tight runway, propose:
- 1st screen: Tue May 25 — 45m (Sanjay can confirm candidate)
- System design: Thu May 27 — 60m (Marissa + Lukasz + Aditya)
- Leadership: Fri May 28 — 30m (Laura/Marissa)

If candidate can’t do those windows, push to week of June 7. Also — remind recruiters background check/org conflict policy (we need an NDA/offer baseline if we progress).

On Wed, May 19, 2027 at 08:46 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks — I’m comfortable approving the requisition to open. Two asks before you post: 
> 1) Confirm ENG-INFRA cost center and job banding (Marissa mentioned ENG-22-42; please put banding in the req form).
> 2) We should target a 3-week interview runway to avoid losing the candidate — please prioritize first-round within May 24–28 if candidate is available.

--- Message 6 (Priya, final summarize & actions) ---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmetalent.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate intro — Jordan Li (Inference Controls Lead)

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 
- Leadership approved opening the req (Laura). Cost center and banding confirmed: ENG-INFRA / ENG-22-42.
- I created the GH job: https://greenhouse.io/boards/redwood/jobs/INF-2027-042 (posting live).
- Sanjay, please book the 45m tech screen for Tue May 25 10:00am PT (candidate confirmed) — recruiter to add calendar invites.
- Panel: Marissa + Lukasz + Aditya for system design on Thu May 27 2:00pm PT; Laura for leadership on Fri May 28 11:00am PT; Rory (security) will join as well.
- Recruiter reminder: submit NDA/background check trigger after HM loop (we’ll confirm after debrief).

Attachments: req_inference_lead_form_v2.xlsx; interview_panel_matrix.docx; JordanLi_Resume.pdf

If anything changes I’ll update the GH posting and follow up with recruiter.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
